sections.what_happened: Overnight: 21 missiles + 210 drones at Ukraine (12 oblasts; 2 killed incl 1 child counted in Kyiv, 34 injured incl 5 children); cluster warhead in central Kyiv; metro infrastructure at Pivdenny Bridge damaged, traffic restricted; Kremenchuk refinery-area energy infrastructure hit. Toward Russia: Sobyanin claims 630 drones at Moscow region, 163 approaching capital, 2 wounded; Lipetsk apartment/medical-facility strike (1 wounded); Tula 70 drones downed. Came hours after Witkoff-Putin St Petersburg meeting and Kremlin 'in principle' trilateral openness after Nov 10.
sections.what_verified: Zelenskyy figures + Kyiv authorities + AFP + Reuters consistent on Kyiv barrage; Sobyanin numbers are Russian-official claims, independently unconfirmed.
sections.what_disputed: Sobyanin drone figures are unilateral Russian claims; Ukraine's exact intercept claims contested (none of the ballistics intercepted — Ukrainian Air Force).
sections.why_matters: The Witkoff mirage: timeline the diplomacy (Witkoff-Putin, 'in principle' talks) against the warhead count of the same night. Map the exchange — Kyiv metro damage vs Moscow-region drone wave.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine — UPDATE: 630 drones toward Moscow claimed (Sobyanin), Kremenchuk refinery hit, Pivdenny Bridge subway damage; 'closest we've been' diplomacy vs continued strikes
